headline: LinkedIn spent $5,328 over 14 days with zero conversions and is paused; Meta is trimmed 20% after a 50% CPA rise; the direct surge looks AI-driven, not paid.

moves.reason: Zero conversions for 14 days (since 10-18) on $5,328 spend, while daily spend rose from ~$300 to ~$460. Last 3 weeks CPA $891 vs $144 earlier. Self-reported LinkedIn share 0% for two weeks (was 4-9%). Pausing is cheap to reverse; possible tracking break should be checked before relaunch.

CPA up 50% over last 3 weeks ($96 vs $64) on flat spend (-3%), level shift began 10-02 ($60 to $100). ROAS 1.86 last week, near 1.5 target. Trim 20% ($500 to $400) while a holdout test confirms; models still put it above target (2.72-4.24), so no full cut.

tests.hypothesis: Meta's reported CPA rise ($64 to $96) reflects real loss of incremental sales, not just last-click shifting to direct/AI-driven journeys. Models give Meta ROAS 2.7-4.2 vs 1.87 platform-reported.
tests.design: Geo holdout: suppress Meta in ~20% of matched regions for 4 weeks. Measure total conversions and revenue (all channels incl. direct) in held-out vs exposed regions. Compare incremental ROAS to the 1.5 target.

tests.hypothesis: The 5.4x direct lift (1.5 to 8.1/day) comes from AI assistant recommendations (self-reported AI+ChatGPT up from ~6% to ~28%), not from paid channels.
tests.design: Add a required, tracked 'How did you hear about us' field with AI-assistant options at checkout for all direct-session buyers; add a landing page/UTM for AI referral traffic. Compare direct volume week-over-week against self-reported AI share for 4 weeks. Don't shift paid budget on this until confirmed.

flag_verdicts.reason: Zero conversions 10-18 to 10-31 on $5,328, daily spend rising $300 to $460. Self-reported LinkedIn share 0% for 2 weeks. Paused.
Meta CPA $64 to $96 over 3 weeks on flat spend (-3%); level shift from 10-02. Trimmed 20% and holdout test recommended. Not cut fully because models put ROAS at 2.7-4.2, above the 1.5 target.
Google spend jump 9/12-9/18 (peak week $6,341) with CPA $19.27 vs $18-19 normal; conversions rose to 329. CPA is back to $16-18 since. No efficiency loss.

Direct 1.5 to 8.1/day while paid spend moved 1.05x. Self-reported AI plus ChatGPT rose from ~4% (Aug) to ~28% (week of 10-26). Consistent with AI-assistant referrals. Don't credit paid channels; verify with tracking.

google_search spend jumped for 7 days (2026-09-12 to 2026-09-18); CPA held at $21 vs $18. Likely fine, confirm before acting.
Direct conversions grew 5.4x (1.5 to 8.1/day) while paid spend moved 1.05x. Self-reported AI answers went from 6% to 24%. Something untracked is driving buyers.
